Hi Samir — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and next step: we recommend a 60–90 minute technical deep-dive with our ML/infra engineers to walk through integration surface, latency/cost targets, and data/security requirements.

Recap (2 min):
- You want low-latency, deterministic inference for clinical summarization and search.
- Primary constraints: PHI-handling, VPC-only deployment, and predictable token costs for batch workloads.
- Key success: proof-of-concept inference at 200 reqs/min with <300ms p95 for short prompts.

Proposed deep-dive goals (60–90m):
1) Architecture walk (20–25m): how Redwood serves models end-to-end (routing, KV cache, quantization profiles).
2) Integration & data flow (20m): ingestion, telemetry, PII handling, retention options.
3) Performance/ops (15–25m): batching, autoscale, fallbacks, and SLA discussion.
4) Next steps & mutual action plan (10m).

Please confirm who from your side should join (ML lead + infra/ops). Suggested Redwood attendees: Ben Carter (Solutions Eng) + Marissa Cole (Sales Manager).

We can host this week — three options in PT (converted below):
- Option A: Tue Jun 22, 09:00–10:30 PT (12:00–13:30 ET)
- Option B: Wed Jun 23, 11:00–12:30 PT (14:00–15:30 ET)
- Option C: Thu Jun 24, 16:00–17:30 PT (19:00–20:30 ET)

Pre-reads: attach our mutual action plan (one-page M.A.P) + a short checklist of infra questions. If you have an architecture diagram or specific data flow doc please share before the call.

Attachments: novamed-mutual-action-plan.xlsx (stub)
